1 name: tag-check
2 
3 # F-Droid builds each new v* tag by itself. This workflow checks the tag first.
4 on:
5   push:
6     tags: ["v*"]
7 
8 jobs:
9   check:
10     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
11     steps:
12       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
13 
14       - name: Tag matches gradle.properties
15         run: |
16           name=$(sed -n 's/^assistkey.versionName=//p' gradle.properties)
17           code=$(sed -n 's/^assistkey.versionCode=//p' gradle.properties)
18           test "v$name" = "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || { echo "Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not match versionName $name"; exit 1; }
19           test -f "fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/changelogs/$code.txt" || { echo "Missing changelogs/$code.txt"; exit 1; }
20           grep -q "^## $name " CHANGELOG.md || { echo "CHANGELOG.md has no entry for $name"; exit 1; }
21 
22       - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
23         with:
24           distribution: temurin
25           java-version: "21"
26 
27       - name: Unit tests and F-Droid build
28         run: ./gradlew testFullDebugUnitTest assembleFdroidRelease
29 
30       - name: F-Droid build has no bundled app and no billing library
31         run: |
32           apk=$(ls app/build/outputs/apk/fdroid/release/*.apk)
33           if unzip -l "$apk" | grep -q "assets/bundled"; then echo "Bundled app in APK"; exit 1; fi
34           for dex in $(unzip -Z1 "$apk" | grep '\.dex$'); do
35             if unzip -p "$apk" "$dex" | grep -aq "billingclient"; then echo "Billing library in APK"; exit 1; fi
36           done
